verdict.rationale: Consensus says it has "evolved from a search tool into a research agent" that chains citation crawling, DOI lookup, author search and similar-paper discovery. It also offers Deep Search for more comprehensive literature reviews across many studies. Together these directly describe multi-step investigation beyond a single-pass summary, but the evidence is short marketing snippets only. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how the agent plans and iterates on its own, a description of Deep Search's step-by-step process, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
